description:
Quote a video job. Pass API fields such as model, duration_seconds and resolution.

For minimax-relight use estimate_video_relight; for minimax-camera-controls use estimate_video_camera;
for lightx-recamera / lightx-relight use estimate_lightx_recamera / estimate_lightx_relight.
Not for higgsfield-* models: use estimate_higgsfield_cinema / estimate_higgsfield_genjutsu /
estimate_higgsfield_restyle / estimate_higgsfield_wan_prime.
name: estimate_video
